Purpose and attempt conditions

School-issued theory task: The teacher supplies the task, duration, permitted resources, assistance, collection and feedback-release rules. This public deck is a briefing, not an assessment paper or marking key. Keep any supported clinic separate; it does not replace the school task.

1. School-issued theory task

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Task-purpose briefing

This preserves the planner’s existing school-issued theory slot and the Week 7 briefing approach. Do not replace it with public ungraded scenario practice. No question, mark, weighting or deadline is authored by this deck.

2. Confirm the issued conditions

Suggested time: 3 minutes

Instructional strategy: Condition check

Use the actual school task instructions. The suggested minutes in this deck are planning placeholders, not imposed assessment conditions. Reallocate the whole slot as required by the issued duration; move administration or follow-up outside the attempt if necessary.

3. Keep practice and assessment separate

Suggested time: 3 minutes

Instructional strategy: Resource boundary

Do not offer a worked network answer immediately before a fresh assessment using the same question. Record any prior exposure according to school procedures. No claim is made that public material is secure.

4. Issued task: follow teacher instructions

Suggested time: 35 minutes

Instructional strategy: Teacher-issued task window

Hold this neutral slide during the attempt. The illustrative 35-minute allocation is not a test duration: the school-issued duration takes precedence. Do not advance to post-collection guidance until all work is collected. Provide access arrangements through school procedures.

5. Stop and submit as instructed

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Collection

This is collection guidance, not an extra task. Follow school instructions for files, paper and late work. Preserve original evidence before later discussion.

6. After collection: record support

Suggested time: 3 minutes

Instructional strategy: Evidence boundary

Only after collection, record relevant prior exposure, interruption or support using school procedures. Do not ask students to disclose personal information publicly. These notes do not set school policy.

7. Feedback only when released

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Feedback-release check

No assessment answer appears in this deck. If feedback cannot be released today, defer the discussion; the task conditions and marking guide remain teacher-controlled.

8. Plan the later review

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Post-task planning

No response to an unreleased question is requested here. A later changed scenario may support teaching, but it does not retroactively alter the submitted task.
